name: Sealwax
author: PixDevs
description: Sealwax in the bar: its icon with the number of unread messages in your Inboxes and folders, and a click that lists where they are and opens Sealwax on a folder. Reads the count Sealwax shares while it runs; never reads your mail.

barWidget.description: Unread mail in your Inboxes and folders; click to see where, and open a folder in Sealwax
